response.original_title: Juston McKinney: It's the Little Things
response.overview: Filmed at The Palace Theatre in Manchester, Juston McKinney’s 6th one-hour comedy special, It’s The Little Things is here. His new hour of material turns the everyday frustrations of middle age into a self-deprecating romp, reflecting on marriage, parenting and suburban life. Finding hilarity in the difficult and mundane moments alike, he riffs on rising costs, his 30-year marriage, his teenage boys who ignore his texts while tracking his every move, and the seemingly impossible task of taking a nap without being judged. At its heart, his 6th hour of comedy is about a husband and father who loves his family, even if he would also really appreciate a little privacy, some cooperation and half an hour of sleep. It’s the Little Things follows his fifth one-hour comedy special On the Bright Side, which has amassed over 1.4 Million views to date.
response.title: Juston McKinney: It's the Little Things
